welcome: Pick a road. Then drive from the shining number!
nudge: Oops, a little off road. Follow the white dashes.
all-done: Beep beep! You drove every letter road!
cruise-intro: Drive each easy road from start to finish.
prompt-l: Start at the star. Drive down, then across.
done-l: Lovely driving! You made the letter L.
prompt-u: Drive down, curve around, and drive back up.
done-u: Up you go! You made the letter U.
prompt-c: Start at the top. Drive around the big curve.
done-c: Cool curve! You made the letter C.
prompt-o: Drive left around the whole loop.
done-o: Oh, what a loop! You made the letter O.
town-intro: Drive the numbered roads in order.
prompt-a: Drive road one, road two, then the little bridge.
done-a: Amazing! You built the letter A.
prompt-t: Drive across the top, then down the middle.
done-t: Terrific turns! You built the letter T.
prompt-h: Down one side, down the other, then cross the bridge.
done-h: Happy honk! You built the letter H.
prompt-k: Drive down, then make the two slanting roads.
done-k: Keep on cruising! You built the letter K.
